summary: CervoMed Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 on September 10, 2026, furnishing an investor presentation and announcing that initial Phase 2a trial results for neflamapimod in nonfluent variant primary progressive aphasia were accepted as a late-breaking oral presentation at the International Society of Frontotemporal Dementias Annual Meeting, October 8–11, 2026, in Philadelphia. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine disclosure of clinical and presentation information, not a special situation; monitor trial data readouts as the operative catalyst.
